name: Shaymin
description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.

moves.name: Leafage
moves.description: The user attacks by pelting the target with leaves.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.description: The user lunges at the target to deal damage, moving at a speed that makes it almost invisible. This also raises the user's action speed.

moves.name: Sleep Powder
moves.description: The user scatters a cloud of sleep-inducing powder that makes the target drowsy.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.description: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky.

moves.name: Recover
moves.description: The user regenerates its cells to restore its own HP.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Seed Flare
moves.description: The user emits a shock wave from its body to attack its target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Hyper Beam
moves.description: The target is attacked with a powerful beam.

moves.name: Psychic
moves.description: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Swift
moves.description: Star-shaped rays are shot at the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user restores its own HP but also becomes drowsy.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.description: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Magical Leaf
moves.description: The user scatters curious leaves that chase the target. This attack never misses.

moves.name: Energy Ball
moves.description: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target’s defensive stats.

moves.name: Earth Power
moves.description: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's defensive stats.

moves.name: Giga Impact
moves.description: The user charges at the target using every bit of its power.

moves.name: Zen Headbutt
moves.description: The user focuses its willpower to its head and attacks the target.

moves.name: Ominous Wind
moves.description: This move can’t be used. It’s recommended that this move is forgotten. Once forgotten, this move can’t be remembered.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.description: The user plays rough with the target and attacks it. This may also lower the target’s offensive stats.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.description: The user emits a powerful flash of light to inflict damage on the target.

moves.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
moves.description: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes. This lowers the target’s offensive stats.
